rationale: The current Premier Cloud aggregate lists Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+, with paired SOAR and enablement. The 8.8 detailed task lists Platform 10.2+ and ES 8.7+ with the assistant, paired SOAR, existing findings, the first ten per detection burst, an approximate 200-per-tenant daily limit, frontier models and connector, investigation, action and asset permissions. The 8.7 task retains historical AI SOC Analyst naming and 8.7+ scope. The current aggregate and editions overview group Triage under Premier, superseding broader historical wording in that specific context. CMP setup evidence is limited to the exact indexed Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+ prerequisites. Direct setup returned 404. Versioned SAIA setup still excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6 for Cloud Connected, describes 2.1.1 without Agent Mode and calls 2.4.0 planned. The ES 8.8 November 4 GA milestone does not resolve usable deployment, exact SOAR pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement or customer authorization.
